Number of graph to draw inside of library

function.abstract: It draws a graph inside of other

description.p: This function draws a graph directly over other, using a coordinates inside of destiny graph, as if it is the background of screen. Unlike , this function has all flexibility to draw the processes, including the cutting of a region.

A limitation of this function is that both graphs must be in the same library. Habitually the destiny graphs are temporal graphs created by , so that it can be use like source graph a copy of a graph of any library to ignore this limitation.
The point specified with the parameters will be equivalent to the zone where is drawn the center of the graph to draw.

The flags are an added or union with the operator | of the following values:
1: Draw the graph reflected horizontally, as seen in a mirror.
2: Draw the graph reflected vertically.
4: Draw the graph with transparency.
128: Draw the graph without having known the transparent pixels of the same one. This option is not compatible with the flag 4.

The region corresponds to a limitation of coordinates. We must know that normally a region is defined with respect to the screen, and in the case of this function, the same limits are applied to a destiny graph that is small. Securely it is necessary to define new regions to use them specifically with this function.
